principle: When a core developer tool fails repeatedly against its own domain, invest in fixing the tool rather than permanently routing around it. (Historical note: file__apply_diff reliability complaints fell off completely after the aggressive format-aware fuzz rewrite landed 2026-07-19/20; the remaining 08-01 concern is under-utilization, not failure.)
source: Promoted from apply_diff reliability insights (item 1 of theme review)

principle: When changing a shared interface, sweep every implementer, consumer, and test mock — not just the source files a plan lists. Adding a method to an engine/registration/context type routinely breaks typecheck/build via stale test mocks and overlooked dispatch sites. Use LSP find-references to enumerate all call sites and implementers (the connected typescript LSP makes this cheap), then grep for the identifier as a belt-and-suspenders cross-check before declaring a cross-cutting change complete.
source: Promoted from mock/call-site sweeping insights (item 2 of theme review)

principle: In TUI/Ink tests, never use fixed-tick or setTimeout barriers before reading the render output — they race against rendering and flake in CI. Poll for the expected content instead (e.g. a waitUntilFrame(f => f.includes('...')) helper with a short poll interval and a timeout).
source: Promoted from racy TUI test barrier insights (item 3 of theme review)

principle: Plugin tools that do read-modify-write on shared state (e.g. a JSON file) must defend against concurrent tool calls — the conversation service runs all tool calls in a turn in parallel via Promise.all. Serialize with an in-process per-key mutex AND use tmp+rename atomic writes, since .drone-agent files aren't always checked into VCS and there's no external safety net.
source: Promoted from parallel tool-execution race insight (item 4 of theme review)

principle: After editing drone-core (or any dependency package) types, run `pnpm -r run build` before relying on LSP/typecheck in dependent packages — they resolve the dependency from its built dist/ (package.json "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"), not from source, so you'll otherwise chase stale diagnostics.
source: Promoted from build/package-resolution insight (item 6 of theme review)
